preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The input string s has exactly n characters.
All characters in s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output string t has the same length as the input string s.
The output string t contains the same multiset of characters as the input string s.
All characters in the output string t are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: palindromic_count(stdout) >= palindromic_count(t) for all t with sorted(t) == sorted(s)
postconditions.description: The output string t has the maximum possible palindromic count among all strings with the same multiset of characters as s.
